recommendation: Keep the no-change audit as-is. No current FHIR-core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-31779; related producedFrom/formOf clarification issues can be audited under their own Jira keys when selected.
issue_request: FHIR-31779 was a Published FHIR-core BRR change request, applied for R5 and resolved Persuasive with Modification. It objected to MedicinalProductPharmaceutical wording saying the administrable product is the same as the manufactured item, because those are conceptually different resources even when the administered form needs no processing or transformation from the manufactured item.
initial_application: The R5 source history applied the correction in the current AdministrableProductDefinition introduction. Commit fbfbf287b1ed7a1add0a216ec02cd2d6daab062c, whose subject lists FHIR#31779, replaced the old 'same as' sentence with 'needs no processinng or transformation'; commit 3ea769b93017e9f6c4500fab63522d37ee6446ba corrected the typo to 'processing', matching Jira's applied-text comment. The old MedicinalProductPharmaceutical artifact maps to the current AdministrableProductDefinition resource in source/fhir.ini.
additional_context: AdministrableProductDefinition and ManufacturedItemDefinition are active current build resources. Later FHIR-41432 wording in AdministrableProductDefinition.producedFrom explicitly allows references across complex many-to-many through simple one-to-one cases even when no transformation or combining is involved, which answers the practical unchanged-form case without reintroducing the misleading idea that the resources are literally the same. FHIR-31778 and FHIR-31785 are same artifact family context; FHIR-31785 is already represented on the combined branch. BRR minutes from 2021-07-06 record the earlier concern that the use case/definition needed more work, and no directly relevant Zulip or conflicting Confluence record was found.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active introduction now says that in some cases the administrable product needs no processing or transformation from the manufactured item, and the active producedFrom definition covers simple unchanged administration cases. Additional local prose for FHIR-31779 would duplicate later accepted wording rather than change implementer understanding.

related_jiras.note: Clarified formOf versus producedFrom in the same AdministrableProductDefinition area, but it is a separate source decision from the misleading 'same as' wording.
